textes.Bienvenue à Blanchecombe, une station de: Welcome to Blanchecombe, a family ski resort in the Alps. Slopes, lifts, passes, lift rides, ski lessons and weather: all the resort’s data is here. You help its team: Hélène, the director, Cyril on the lifts, Bruno, the head of ski patrol, Fanny at the ticket desk and Diane at the ski school. Explore the database to solve the missions.
textes.Une ligne par remontée mécanique de la s: One row per ski lift at the resort: its name, its type, its sector, the altitude of its base and top stations, its capacity, the year it opened and its status on February 23, 2025.
textes.Une ligne par piste balisée : son nom, s: One row per marked slope: its name, its color, its sector, its length, its vertical drop, the lift that takes you to its start and its status on February 23, 2025. A link slope is reached from another slope, without a lift.
textes.Une ligne par client qui a créé un compt: One row per customer who created an account, whether or not they bought a pass: first name, last name, date of birth, city and email address.
textes.Une ligne par forfait vendu pour l’hiver: One row per pass sold for the 2024-2025 winter: its holder, its type, its rate, its price, its purchase and validity dates. A customer can have several passes; a pass sold at the desk without an account has no holder.
textes.Une ligne par passage d’un forfait au po: One row per time a pass goes through a lift gate, from February 10 to 23, 2025, with its date and time. A pass can go through the gates many times, or never.
textes.Une ligne par moniteur de l’école de ski: One row per ski school instructor: first name, last name, specialty and the year they got certified.
textes.Une ligne par cours collectif de l’école: One row per group lesson at the ski school, from February 10 to 23, 2025: its instructor, its discipline, its level, its date, its start time, its duration, its number of spots, its price and its status.
textes.Une ligne par inscription d’un client à: One row per enrollment of a customer in a group lesson. A customer can take several lessons; a lesson can have no one enrolled.
textes.Une ligne par jour, du 10 au 23 février: One row per day, from February 10 to 23, 2025: the ski patrol’s report (snow depth, fresh snow, temperature, wind, avalanche risk) and whether the ski area was open that day.
textes.Nom de la remontée, type compris (ex. «: Name of the lift, type included (e.g. “Marmottes Chairlift”).
textes.Type de remontée : « Télécabine », « Tél: Lift type: “Gondola”, “Chairlift”, “Drag lift” or “Magic carpet” (the free conveyor belt in the kids’ snow garden, with no gate).
textes.Secteur du domaine skiable d’où part la: Sector of the ski area the lift starts from: “Village”, “Forêt”, “Combe” or “Crêtes”.
textes.Altitude de la gare de départ, en mètres: Altitude of the base station, in meters.
textes.Altitude de la gare d’arrivée, en mètres: Altitude of the top station, in meters.
textes.Débit : nombre maximal de personnes tran: Capacity: maximum number of people carried in an hour.
textes.État de la remontée au 23 février 2025 :: Status of the lift on February 23, 2025: “Open”, “Closed” or “Under maintenance”.
textes.Couleur, de la plus facile à la plus dif: Color, from the easiest to the hardest: “Green”, “Blue”, “Red” or “Black”.
textes.Secteur du domaine skiable : « Village »: Sector of the ski area: “Village”, “Forêt”, “Combe” or “Crêtes”.
Length of the slope, in meters.
textes.Dénivelé de la piste : la différence d’a: Vertical drop of the slope: the difference in altitude between its start and its end, in meters.
textes.La remontée qui mène au départ de la pis: The lift that takes you to the start of the slope; empty (NULL) for a link slope, reached from another slope.
textes.État de la piste au 23 février 2025 : «: Status of the slope on February 23, 2025: “Open”, “Closed” or “Being groomed” (being prepared by the snow groomers).
textes.Ville de résidence, écrite en français (: City of residence, written in English (e.g. “Lyon”, “London”, “Geneva”).
textes.Adresse e-mail, unique ; vide (NULL) si: Email address, unique; empty (NULL) if the customer didn’t give one, like most children.
textes.Numéro unique du forfait, attribué dans: Unique number of the pass, given in order of sale.
textes.Le client titulaire du forfait ; vide (N: The customer who holds the pass; empty (NULL) for a pass sold at the desk to a skier without an account.
textes.Type de forfait : « Journée » (1 jour),: Pass type: “Day” (1 day), “Week” (6 days in a row) or “Season” (the whole winter, until April 21, 2025).
textes.Tarif appliqué à la vente : « Enfant »,: Rate applied at sale: “Child”, “Adult” or “Senior”. It depends on the holder’s age on the first valid day: under 12 for “Child”, 65 and over for “Senior”.
Price paid for the pass, in euros.
textes.Dernier jour de validité (AAAA-MM-JJ), c: Last valid day (YYYY-MM-DD), that day included.
Unique ID of the lift ride.
The pass shown at the gate.
textes.Heure du passage, au format HH:MM (ex. «: Time of the ride, in HH:MM format (e.g. “09:05”).
textes.Année d’obtention de son diplôme de moni: Year they got their instructor certification.
textes.Heure de début, au format HH:MM : « 09:0: Start time, in HH:MM format: “09:00” in the morning, “14:00” in the afternoon.
Duration of the lesson, in minutes.
Number of spots in the group.
Price of the lesson for one student, in euros.
textes.Statut du cours : « Maintenu » ou « Annu: Status of the lesson: “Held” or “Cancelled”; the enrollments of a cancelled lesson stay recorded.
textes.L’élève inscrit ; on ne s’inscrit qu’une: The enrolled student; you can only enroll once in the same lesson.
textes.Date du jour (AAAA-MM-JJ) ; une seule li: Date of the day (YYYY-MM-DD); only one row per day.
textes.Hauteur de neige au sommet du domaine, m: Snow depth at the top of the ski area, measured in the morning, in centimeters.
textes.Neige fraîche tombée en 24 heures, en ce: Fresh snow fallen in 24 hours, in centimeters; 0 if it didn’t snow.
textes.Température relevée à 8 h au pied des pi: Temperature taken at 8 a.m. at the bottom of the slopes, in degrees Celsius; negative when it’s freezing.
textes.Rafale de vent la plus forte de la journ: Strongest wind gust of the day at the top of the Crêtes, in km/h; empty (NULL) when the anemometer was broken.
textes.Risque d’avalanche annoncé, de 1 (faible: Forecast avalanche risk, from 1 (low) to 5 (very high).
textes.Ouverture du domaine skiable ce jour-là: Status of the ski area that day: “Fully open”, “Partly open” (some lifts closed) or “Fully closed” (all lifts closed).
textes.Raison de la fermeture, totale ou partie: Reason for the closure, full or partial: “Wind” or “Fog”; empty (NULL) on “Fully open” days.
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Each slope has a color that shows its difficulty, from green, the easiest, to black, the hardest. It also has a status for the day: open, closed or being groomed, meaning being prepared. You reach the start of a slope by a lift, or sometimes from another slope. Every morning, Bruno, the head of ski patrol, posts the board of open black slopes for advanced skiers, with their length and the lift to take.
textes.le nom de la remontée qui mène à son dép: the name of the lift that takes you to its start
textes.les pistes de couleur « Noire » à l’état: the slopes with the color “Black” and the status “Open”
textes.Les tables `pistes` et `remontees` ont c: The `slopes` and `lifts` tables each have a `name` column and a `status` column: the status asked for is the slope’s.
textes.Le nom de la remontée est rangé avec les: The lift’s name is stored with the lifts: link each slope to the one that takes you to its start. Two conditions on the slope, true at the same time: its color and its status.
textes.Quelles remontées ont le plus grand déni: Which lifts have the biggest vertical rise?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Its lifts, from the magic carpet to the gondola, go up from a base station to a top station, each at its own altitude, between 1,450 and 2,430 meters. The difference in altitude between the two stations is called the vertical rise. Cyril, the head of the lifts, is welcoming the inspectors for the annual safety visit. He wants to start with the 3 lifts that have the biggest vertical rise.
textes.son dénivelé, en mètres : l’altitude d’a: its vertical rise, in meters: the top altitude minus the base altitude
textes.Le dénivelé n’est pas noté tel quel : ca: The vertical rise isn’t stored as is: calculate it by subtracting the two altitudes. Then sort on that calculation, from largest to smallest, and keep 3 rows.
textes.Quels forfaits ont été vendus sans compt: Which passes were sold without a customer account?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Each pass sold this winter has a type (day, week or season), a rate (child, adult or senior) and valid days. The customer with an account becomes its holder. But a skier without an account can also buy their pass at the desk: the pass then has no holder, and the cell stays empty. Fanny, who runs the ticket desk, is preparing her report. She wants to review these passes without a holder, with their rate, their price and their first valid day.
textes.les forfaits sans titulaire, c’est-à-dir: the passes without a holder, meaning those whose customer is empty (NULL)
textes.par premier jour de validité, puis par i: by first valid day, then by pass ID
textes.Un forfait sans titulaire se reconnaît à: A pass without a holder is one whose customer cell is empty. You can’t compare an empty cell with an equals sign: there’s a separate way to ask whether a cell is empty.
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. To go up, a skier shows their pass at a lift gate, and each ride is recorded with its date and time. On February 18, fog closed the lifts in the Crêtes sector. Hélène, the director, is replying to unhappy skiers. She wants the list of lifts that still recorded rides that day, each one only once.
textes.le nom de la remontée (chaque remontée u: the name of the lift (each lift only once)
textes.seulement les remontées qui ont au moins: only the lifts with at least one ride on February 18, 2025
textes.Relie chaque passage à sa remontée pour: Link each ride to its lift to read its name, and keep the date February 18, written year-month-day. A lift taken several times would come back several times: ask to show each row only once.
textes.Quels jours le domaine n’a-t-il pas enti: On which days wasn’t the ski area fully open?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Every morning, the ski patrol, in charge of safety on the slopes, records the snow, the temperature and the wind. They also note whether the ski area is fully open, partly open, or fully closed, with the reason for a closure. Bruno, their head, is writing the weather report for the February vacation for the town hall. He’s listing the days when the ski area wasn’t fully open, with the reason and the wind strength.
textes.l’état du domaine ce jour-là: the status of the ski area that day
textes.la rafale de vent la plus forte, en km/h: the strongest wind gust, in km/h, an empty cell (NULL) if the wind wasn’t measured
textes.les jours où l’état du domaine n’est pas: the days when the ski area’s status isn’t “Fully open”, meaning “Partly open” or “Fully closed”
textes.Une seule condition sur l’état du domain: A single condition on the ski area’s status: leave out the “Fully open” days, or keep the two other statuses. Dates written year-month-day sort directly.
textes.Que faut-il imprimer sur les badges des: What should be printed on the instructors’ badges?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Its ski school has six instructors, each a ski or snowboard specialist. Diane, who runs the school, is ordering their badges for the end of the season. Each badge will show the first name followed by the last name in capitals, like “Lise ARNAUD”, then, just below, the instructor’s specialty.
textes.dans une seule colonne, le prénom puis l: in a single column, the first name then the last name in capitals, separated by a space (e.g. “Lise ARNAUD”)
textes.Il faut coller des textes bout à bout :: You need to stick texts together end to end: the first name, a space, then the last name in capitals. A function turns a text into capitals, and an operator sticks two texts together.
textes.Combien de passages le samedi 15 février: How many lift rides on Saturday, February 15?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Each time a pass goes through a lift gate, a ride is recorded; the same pass often goes through several times a day. Saturday, February 15, arrival day, was busy. Cyril, the head of the lifts, is planning his Saturday crews. He wants to know how many rides the gates recorded that day, and how many different passes went through.
textes.le nombre de passages enregistrés ce jou: the number of rides recorded that day
textes.le nombre de forfaits différents passés: the number of different passes that went through the gates that day
textes.Un même forfait passe souvent plusieurs: The same pass often goes through the gates several times a day.
textes.Garde les passages du 15 février. Compte: Keep the rides on February 15. Then count two things: all the rows, then the different passes, counting each one only once.
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. It sells passes by the day, by the week, or for the season: the last one gives access to the slopes all winter, from December to April. The holder of a Season pass has an account, with their email address. Fanny, who runs the pass desk, is launching the presale for next winter. She wants to write to each holder of a Season pass this winter to offer to renew it, reminding them of the price paid.
textes.le prix payé pour son forfait Saison, en: the price paid for their Season pass, in euros
textes.Le titulaire n’est qu’un numéro dans le: The holder is only a number in the pass: link each pass to the matching customer to read their name and email. Then keep only the type “Season”.
textes.Quelle est la pente des pistes rouges ?: What is the gradient of the red slopes?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Each slope has a length and a vertical drop, the difference in altitude between its start and its end, both in meters. Its color shows its difficulty, from green to black. Hélène, the director, is having the slope map redone. Next to each red slope, she wants to print its average gradient, as a percentage, to help skiers choose their run.
textes.sa pente moyenne, en pourcentage : son d: its average gradient, as a percentage: its vertical drop × 100 ÷ its length, rounded to one decimal place
textes.Le dénivelé et la longueur sont des nomb: The vertical drop and the length are whole numbers: between two whole numbers, division loses its decimals.
textes.La pente se calcule : le dénivelé fois 1: The gradient is calculated as: the vertical drop times 100, divided by the length. Between two whole numbers, division loses its decimals: slip a decimal number into the calculation, then round.
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Its ski school offers group ski or snowboard lessons during the vacation, from February 10 to 23, 2025; some were cancelled. Diane, who runs the school, pays the Saturday and Sunday teaching hours separately. For her vacation review, she wants the lessons that were held on a weekend, with the instructor who taught them.
textes.le prénom du moniteur qui l’a donné: the first name of the instructor who taught it
textes.seulement les cours au statut « Maintenu: only the lessons with the status “Held”
textes.seulement ceux qui ont eu lieu un samedi: only those that took place on a Saturday or a Sunday
textes.par date, puis par heure de début: by date, then by start time
textes.Avec le format %w, strftime donne le jou: With the %w format, strftime gives the day of the week as text, from “0” for Sunday to “6” for Saturday.
textes.Relie chaque cours à son moniteur. Garde: Link each lesson to its instructor. Keep the lessons that were held, then those that fell on a Saturday or a Sunday: a date function gives the day of the week as a digit.
textes.Combien de passages chaque remontée a-t-: How many rides has each lift counted?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Its nine lifts, from the Oursons magic carpet to the Crêtes chairlift, record each pass that goes through their gate. Cyril, the head of the lifts, is planning the spring maintenance: cables and pulleys wear with each ride. He wants the number of rides of each lift during the vacation, including those that have none.
textes.son nombre de passages, 0 si elle n’en a: its number of rides, 0 if it has none
textes.toutes les remontées, y compris celles q: every lift, including those that recorded no ride
textes.par nombre de passages, du plus grand au: by number of rides, largest first, then by lift name
textes.Pars de toutes les remontées, même sans: Start from every lift, even without a ride, then count their rides. Counting the rows would give 1 to a lift without a ride: count the rides actually found instead.
textes.Quels mois les ventes de forfaits ont-el: In which months were pass sales over €1,500?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Its winter passes are sold from November to February, with or without a customer account, each at its own price. Fanny, who runs the pass desk, is planning extra staff for next winter. She’s spotting the months when sales brought in more than €1,500, with the number of passes sold and their average price, to open a second desk then.
textes.le mois d’achat, au format AAAA-MM, par: the purchase month, in YYYY-MM format, for example “2024-11”
textes.le nombre de forfaits achetés ce mois-là: the number of passes bought that month
textes.la recette du mois : la somme de leurs p: the month’s revenue: the sum of their prices, in euros
textes.le prix moyen d’un forfait acheté ce moi: the average price of a pass bought that month, in euros, rounded to two decimal places
textes.tous les forfaits, y compris ceux vendus: every pass, including those sold at the desk without an account
textes.seulement les mois dont la recette dépas: only the months whose revenue is strictly above €1,500
textes.Extrais le mois de chaque date d’achat e: Extract the month from each purchase date and make one group per month. The condition applies to the sum of the prices: it applies once the grouping is done, not row by row.
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Its ski school gives group lessons, which students enroll in one by one. Each lesson has a limited number of spots, from 3 to 6 students, and can be held or cancelled. Diane, who runs the school, wants to open more groups next winter where demand overflows. She’s spotting the lessons held that filled all their spots during the vacation.
textes.seulement ceux dont le nombre d’inscrits: only those whose number of students enrolled reaches or exceeds their number of spots
textes.Compte les inscrits de chaque cours main: Count the students enrolled in each lesson held. The comparison with the number of spots applies to that count: it applies once the counting is done, not row by row.
textes.Combien de pistes sont ouvertes dans cha: How many slopes are open in each color?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Each slope has a color (green, blue, red or black), a length in meters and a status for the day: open, closed or being groomed, meaning being prepared. Every morning, Bruno, the head of ski patrol, posts the slope report on the resort’s website. For each color, he announces how many slopes are open out of the total, and how many kilometers they offer.
textes.son nombre total de pistes, quel que soi: its total number of slopes, whatever their status
textes.son nombre de pistes à l’état « Ouverte: its number of slopes with the status “Open”
textes.la longueur totale de ses pistes ouverte: the total length of its open slopes, in kilometers, rounded to one decimal place
textes.par nombre de pistes ouvertes, du plus g: by number of open slopes, largest first, then by color, in alphabetical order
textes.La longueur des pistes est enregistrée e: The slopes’ length is stored in meters: 1 km is 1,000 m.
textes.Forme un groupe par couleur et compte to: Make one group per color and count all its slopes. To count only the open ones without losing the others, count 1 for an open slope and 0 otherwise; do the same with their length, then convert to kilometers.
textes.Quels forfaits ne sont passés à aucun po: Which passes didn’t go through any gate during the vacation?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. During the vacation, from February 10 to 23, 2025, each time a pass goes through a lift gate is recorded. A pass sold at the desk to a skier without an account has no holder. Fanny, who runs the pass desk, is surprised: some passes didn’t go through any gate during that vacation. She wants to review them, with their holder when there is one, to understand and, if needed, offer a goodwill gesture.
textes.le prénom de son titulaire, case vide (N: its holder’s first name, an empty cell (NULL) for a pass sold at the desk without an account
textes.le nom de son titulaire, case vide (NULL: its holder’s last name, an empty cell (NULL) in that same case
textes.seulement les forfaits qui n’ont aucun p: only the passes that have no ride in the lift_rides table, which covers the vacation, from February 10 to 23, 2025
textes.y compris les forfaits vendus en caisse: including the passes sold at the desk without an account
textes.Associe à chaque forfait ses passages, e: Match each pass with its rides, keeping the passes that have none, and keep only those. For the holder, also keep the passes that don’t have one: their name will stay empty.
textes.À quels moments de la journée les portiq: At what times of day are the gates busiest?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. The lift gates record the time of each ride, from opening in the morning to mid-afternoon. Cyril, the head of the lifts, is organizing the hours of his gate attendants. He wants to know how many rides fall into each time slot of the day, to add staff at peak times.
textes.le créneau : « Ouverture » avant 09:00,: the time slot: “Opening” before 09:00, “Morning” from 09:00 to 11:59, “Midday” from 12:00 to 13:59, “Afternoon” from 14:00
textes.par nombre de passages, du plus grand au: by number of rides, largest first
textes.L’heure du passage est un texte au forma: The ride time is text in HH:MM format: it compares like text, with “08:59” coming before “09:00”.
textes.Range chaque heure de passage dans son c: File each ride time into its slot, testing the cut-off times in order: the first true condition wins. Then make one group per slot and count its rides.
textes.Quels jours ont été plus enneigés que la: Which days had more snow than average?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Every morning of the vacation, from February 10 to 23, 2025, the ski patrol measures the snow depth at the top of the ski area. Bruno, their head, is preparing the snow report. He wants the days when the snow depth was above the two-week average, to compare them with the schedule of his snow groomers, the machines that prepare the slopes.
textes.la hauteur de neige ce jour-là, en centi: the snow depth that day, in centimeters
textes.seulement les jours dont la hauteur de n: only the days whose snow depth is strictly above the average snow depth of the 14 days in the `weather` table
textes.Calcule d’abord la moyenne des hauteurs: First calculate the average snow depth over all the days, in a separate query, then compare each day’s depth with that result.
textes.Combien de jours à l’avance achète-t-on: How many days in advance do people buy their pass?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Each pass has a purchase date and a first valid day; some skiers buy it weeks in advance. Hélène, the director, wants to reward early purchases with a discount. Before setting the deadlines, she wants to know, for each pass type, how many days before its first valid day it’s bought on average.
textes.le délai moyen d’achat, en jours, arrond: the average purchase lead time, in days, rounded to one decimal place: the average, over its passes, of the first valid day minus the purchase date
textes.par délai moyen, du plus long au plus co: by average lead time, longest first
textes.Un forfait acheté le jour même de son pr: A pass bought on its first valid day has a lead time of 0 days.
textes.Les dates sont enregistrées en texte : u: Dates are stored as text: a direct subtraction, like start_date - purchase_date, doesn’t cause any error but only subtracts the years; julianday first turns each date into a number of days.
textes.Calcule le délai de chaque forfait en jo: Calculate each pass’s lead time in days between its two dates: since the dates are text, a function first has to turn them into numbers of days. Then make one group per type and take the average.
textes.Quels élèves ont suivi les cours d’Océan: Which students took Océane Perrin’s lessons?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Each group lesson at the ski school is taught by an instructor, and students enroll one by one. Diane, who runs the school, is preparing the end-of-course certificates. The instructor Océane Perrin wants to sign each of her students’ certificates herself: she needs those who took at least one of her lessons that were held.
textes.le prénom de l’élève (une ligne par élèv: the student’s first name (one row per student, even if they took several of her lessons)
textes.seulement les élèves inscrits à au moins: only the students enrolled in at least one of Océane Perrin’s lessons with the status “Held”
textes.Passe de la monitrice à ses cours, puis: Go from the instructor to her lessons, then to the enrollments and finally to the students. A student enrolled in several of her lessons would appear several times: ask to show each row only once.
textes.Quelle remontée mène à chaque piste ouve: Which lift takes you to each open slope?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. You reach the start of most slopes by a lift. A link slope, though, is reached from another slope: it has no lift, and the cell stays empty. Hélène, the director, is having the pocket map of open slopes printed. Next to each slope, she wants to show the lift that takes you to its start, or “Link” for a slope reached from another slope.
textes.le nom de la remontée qui mène à son dép: the name of the lift that takes you to its start, or the text “Link” if it has none
textes.seulement les pistes à l’état « Ouverte: only the slopes with the status “Open”
textes.y compris les pistes de liaison, sans re: including the link slopes, without a lift
textes.par secteur, puis par nom de la piste: by sector, then by slope name
textes.Associe à chaque piste ouverte sa remont: Match each open slope with its lift, also keeping the link slopes, which have none. A function then replaces an empty cell with the text of your choice.
textes.Quel est le classement des moniteurs par: How do the instructors rank by enrollments?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. The six instructors at its ski school teach group lessons, held or cancelled, which students enroll in. Hélène, the director, is splitting the instructors’ end-of-season bonus based on their activity during the vacation. She ranks them by number of enrollments in their lessons that were held, including those who have none.
textes.son nombre d’inscriptions à des cours ma: their number of enrollments in lessons held, 0 if they have none
textes.son rang : 1 pour le plus d’inscriptions: their rank: 1 for the most enrollments, ties share the same rank and the next rank doesn’t skip (1, 2, 2, 3)
textes.tous les moniteurs, y compris ceux qui n: every instructor, including those with no lesson held
textes.Chaque inscription compte : un élève ins: Each enrollment counts: a student enrolled in 3 lessons counts 3 times.
textes.Les inscriptions aux cours au statut « A: Enrollments in lessons with the status “Cancelled” don’t count.
textes.Pars de tous les moniteurs. Si tu écarte: Start from every instructor. If you leave out the cancelled lessons afterwards, the instructors without a lesson held disappear: put that condition where you link their lessons. Then rank them, without leaving a gap after ties.
textes.Quels jours la hauteur de neige a-t-elle: On which days did the snow depth go down?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. The snow depth varies from one day to the next, with snowfall, settling and melting. Bruno, the head of ski patrol, measures it every day of the vacation. To schedule the snow cannons, which make snow, he wants the days when it went down since the day before, and by how much.
textes.la hauteur de neige de la veille, en cen: the snow depth the day before, in centimeters
textes.l’écart : la hauteur du jour moins celle: the change: the day’s depth minus the day before’s (a negative number)
textes.seulement les jours où la hauteur de nei: only the days when the snow depth is strictly below the day before’s
textes.sans le 10 février, premier jour de la t: without February 10, the first day in the `weather` table, which has no day before
textes.La veille est le jour qui précède, par d: The day before is the previous day, by date, in the `weather` table.
textes.Pour chaque jour, il faut lire la hauteu: For each day, you need to read the depth from the row just before: a function lets you do that. But you can’t filter directly on its result: calculate it separately first, then keep the drops.
textes.Comment les passages s’additionnent-ils: How do the rides add up day after day?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. The gates record every pass that goes through, but none on the days when the ski area is closed because of the wind. Cyril, the head of the lifts, keeps the lifts’ wear log. Day after day, he wants the number of rides and their running total since February 10, closed days included, to schedule the next inspections.
textes.la date (une ligne pour chacun des 14 jo: the date (one row for each of the 14 days in the `weather` table)
textes.le nombre de passages ce jour-là, 0 s’il: the number of rides that day, 0 if there were none
textes.le cumul des passages depuis le 10 févri: the running total of rides since February 10, that day included
textes.tous les jours de la table `meteo`, y co: every day in the `weather` table, including those without any ride
textes.Pars des jours de la météo, qui ont chac: Start from the weather days, which each have their own row, and match them with their rides: a day without a ride stays. Count per day, then add these counts up as you go, in date order.
textes.Combien rembourser au titre de la garant: How much should be refunded under the Closure guarantee?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. A Day or Week pass is valid for one or more days in a row, and the ski area sometimes closes entirely because of the wind. The Closure guarantee then refunds the lost days, pro rata: the share of the price matching the closed days. Fanny, who runs the pass desk, is preparing the refunds of the Day and Week passes whose validity included at least one fully closed day.
textes.le nombre de jours de sa validité où l’é: the number of its valid days when the ski area’s status was “Fully closed”
textes.le montant à rembourser, en euros, arron: the amount to refund, in euros, rounded to two decimal places: price × closed days ÷ number of valid days
textes.seulement les forfaits de type « Journée: only the passes of type “Day” or “Week”
textes.seulement ceux dont la validité compte a: only those whose validity includes at least one day when the ski area’s status is “Fully closed”
textes.La validité va du premier au dernier jou: The validity runs from the pass’s first to last day, both days included: a Week pass is worth 6 days, a Day pass 1 day.
textes.Les jours « Partiel » ne donnent droit à: “Partly open” days don’t give any right to a refund.
textes.Associe à chaque forfait les jours fermé: Match each pass with the closed days whose date falls between its two validity dates, then count them. The validity length is calculated from the two dates, turned into numbers of days.
textes.Quel est le taux de remplissage de chaqu: What is the fill rate of each type of lesson?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Its ski school gives group ski or snowboard lessons, from beginner to advanced level, each with a set number of spots; some are cancelled. Diane, who runs the school, is building next winter’s schedule. For each discipline and each level, she wants to know what share of the spots offered in the lessons held actually found a student.
textes.la discipline (une ligne par discipline: the discipline (one row per discipline and per level)
textes.le nombre d’inscrits à ces cours: the number of students enrolled in these lessons
textes.le nombre de places offertes : la somme: the number of spots offered: the sum of these lessons’ spots
textes.le taux de remplissage, en pourcentage,: the fill rate, as a percentage out of 100: enrolled × 100 ÷ spots, rounded to one decimal place
textes.seulement les cours au statut « Maintenu: only the lessons with the status “Held”, including those with no one enrolled
textes.Les places d’un cours ne comptent qu’une: A lesson’s spots only count once, whatever its number of students enrolled.
textes.Procède en deux temps : compte d’abord l: Work in two steps: first count the students enrolled in each lesson held, keeping the empty lessons. Then add up enrolled students and spots per discipline and level: that way, a lesson’s spots only count once.
textes.Quelles pistes sont plus raides que la m: Which slopes are steeper than the average for their color?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. A slope’s gradient is calculated from its vertical drop and its length, and its color should announce its difficulty. Bruno, the head of ski patrol, is reviewing the markings before next winter. A slope much steeper than the others of its color surprises skiers: he wants those whose gradient is above the average gradient of their color, whatever their status.
textes.sa pente, en pourcentage : dénivelé × 10: its gradient, as a percentage: vertical drop × 100 ÷ length, rounded to one decimal place
textes.la moyenne des pentes des pistes de sa c: the average gradient of the slopes of its color, rounded to one decimal place
textes.seulement celles dont la pente dépasse s: only those whose gradient is strictly above the average for their color
textes.par couleur, dans l’ordre alphabétique,: by color, in alphabetical order, then by gradient, steepest first
textes.La moyenne d’une couleur est la moyenne: A color’s average is the average of its slopes’ gradients, not their total vertical drop divided by their total length.
textes.Compare la pente à la moyenne avant de l: Compare the gradient with the average before rounding them.
textes.Procède en deux temps : calcule d’abord: Work in two steps: first calculate each slope’s gradient, then the average of these gradients per color. Finally, compare each slope with its color’s average, before rounding.
textes.Qui a pris toutes les remontées des Crêt: Who has taken every lift in the Crêtes sector?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Its ski area is split into four sectors, from the Village to the Crêtes, and each ride through the gates shows the lift and the pass used. A customer can have several passes. Cyril, the head of the lifts, is launching the “Crêtes Ace” badge for the skiers who have taken every lift in the Crêtes sector, all their passes combined. He wants the list of customers who deserve it.
textes.seulement les clients qui ont au moins u: only the customers with at least one ride on each of the lifts in the “Crêtes” sector, whatever pass they used
textes.Un client peut avoir plusieurs forfaits: A customer can have several passes: their rides count together.
textes.Un forfait vendu en caisse sans compte n: A pass sold at the desk without an account has no holder and counts for no one.
textes.Retourne la question : un client convien: Turn the question around: a customer fits if there’s no Crêtes lift they’ve never been on. This double negative becomes two checks for absence, one inside the other, going through their passes.
textes.Qui a passé le premier portique de chaqu: Who went through the first gate of each day?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Every morning, the first pass through a gate wins a free day of skiing. A pass sold at the desk to a skier without an account has no holder. Fanny, who runs the pass desk, wants the list of winners, day by day. When the winning pass has no holder, she’ll post its number at the desk so its owner can come and collect their prize.
textes.la date (une ligne par jour où au moins: the date (one row per day when at least one ride was recorded)
textes.l’heure du premier passage de la journée: the time of the day’s first ride
textes.l’identifiant du forfait gagnant: the ID of the winning pass
textes.seulement le premier passage de chaque j: only the first ride of each day, the one with the earliest time
textes.Chaque jour, un seul passage a lieu à la: Each day, only one ride happens at the earliest minute: there are no ties.
textes.Numérote les passages de chaque jour par: Number each day’s rides by time, with the numbering starting again at 1 each day, and keep number 1. Then join the holder, keeping the passes that don’t have one.
textes.Avec qui Lina Vidal a-t-elle partagé un: Who did Lina Vidal share a lesson with?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. Children on a course at the ski school share their group lessons with other students. Diane, who runs the school, is helping Lina Vidal’s parents: their daughter turns 10 on February 18, during her course. They want to invite to her party the children who shared at least one lesson held with her; a cancelled lesson didn’t take place.
textes.le prénom de l’enfant (une ligne par enf: the child’s first name (one row per child, even if they shared several lessons with Lina Vidal)
textes.seulement les élèves inscrits à au moins: only the students enrolled in at least one lesson held that Lina Vidal is also enrolled in
textes.Seuls les cours au statut « Maintenu » c: Only the lessons with the status “Held” count: a cancelled lesson didn’t take place.
textes.Passe deux fois par les inscriptions : u: Go through the enrollments twice: once to find Lina Vidal’s lessons, once to find the others enrolled in those same lessons. Leave out Lina herself, and show each child only once.
textes.Quels forfaits ont été vendus au mauvais: Which passes were sold at the wrong rate?
textes.Blanchecombe est une station de ski fami: Blanchecombe is a family ski resort in the Alps. A pass’s rate depends on its holder’s age on the first valid day: child under 12, adult from 12 to 64, senior from 65. Hélène, the director, is having the sales checked before closing the accounts. She wants the passes whose rate doesn’t match that age, to correct them; passes without a holder can’t be checked.
textes.son âge au premier jour de validité du f: their age on the pass’s first valid day, in completed years
textes.le tarif qui correspond à cet âge: the rate that matches this age
textes.seulement les forfaits dont le tarif dif: only the passes whose rate differs from the rate that matches the holder’s age
textes.sans les forfaits vendus en caisse sans: without the passes sold at the desk without an account, whose holder isn’t known
textes.Tarif « Enfant » : moins de 12 ans ; « A: “Child” rate: under 12; “Adult”: from 12 to 64; “Senior”: 65 and over.
textes.En années révolues, l’âge augmente le jo: In completed years, age goes up on the birthday: a child born on March 20, 2015 is 9 on February 10, 2025.
textes.Calcule d’abord l’âge : la différence de: First calculate the age: the difference in years, minus 1 if the birthday hasn’t happened yet that day. Work out the expected rate from it, then keep the passes where it differs from the rate sold.
